children: has acquired Radford Studio Center in Los Angeles in a $380M deal that will give the streaming giant access to a legacy Hollywood studio and increase its production capabilities in California.

Entertainment advisory unit ZVantage has been engaged to support the transition, while Cinelease will continue to serve as the production equipment provider at the studio to maintain operational continuity and retain the existing studio team.

Purchased through a forfeiture auction, the $380M price tag is a fraction of what the studio sold for 5 years ago. In 2021, Hackman Capital Partners paid $1.85B for Radford but defaulted on the mortgage as production levels plummeted amid a film industry flight from California.

title: Netflix buys Hollywood's Radford Studios for $380M
